from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "- PDFs describe variables with infinite possible values.",
            "- Remember that area always represents probability.",
            "- Total area must sum to exactly one."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Summary & Visual Recap", lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        COLOR_1 = BLUE_B
        COLOR_2 = YELLOW_B
        COLOR_3 = GREEN_B

        # Assets
        BELL_PATH = "/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bell.svg"

        # Axes for the curves
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 4, 1],
            y_range=[0, 1.5, 0.5],
            axis_config={"include_tip": False},
            x_length=4.5,
            y_length=3
        )
        # Fix Issue 33: Shift axes right to avoid crowding (A2 instead of A1)
        self.place_in_area(axes, "A2", "F6", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # Create curves
        # Hidden bell plot for calculations
        bell_plot = axes.plot(lambda x: 1.2 * np.exp(-((x-2)**2) / 0.5), color=COLOR_1)
        
        # Bell SVG - Fix Issue 19
        bell_svg = SVGMobject(BELL_PATH, color=COLOR_1)
        # Align SVG with the hidden plot
        bell_svg.move_to(bell_plot.get_center()).scale_to_fit_width(bell_plot.width).scale_to_fit_height(bell_plot.height * 0.95)
        
        uniform = axes.plot(
            lambda x: 0.6 if 1 <= x <= 3 else 0.0001, 
            color=COLOR_1, 
            use_smoothing=False, 
            discontinuities=[1, 3],
            dt=0.01
        )
        exponential = axes.plot(lambda x: 1.2 * np.exp(-x), color=COLOR_1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(COLOR_1))
        
        self.play(Create(axes))
        # Initial curve is the bell SVG
        self.play(FadeIn(bell_svg))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Cycle through shapes quickly
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(bell_svg, uniform), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(uniform, exponential), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(0.3)
        
        # Create a fresh bell_svg for the next part (to replace the exponential)
        bell_svg_final = SVGMobject(BELL_PATH, color=COLOR_1)
        bell_svg_final.move_to(bell_plot.get_center()).scale_to_fit_width(bell_plot.width).scale_to_fit_height(bell_plot.height * 0.95)
        
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(exponential, bell_svg_final), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(COLOR_2))
        
        # Highlight a shaded region
        # Use bell_plot for shading calculation
        shade_area = axes.get_area(bell_plot, x_range=[1.4, 2.6], color=COLOR_2, opacity=0.5)
        prob_label = MathTex("P(a < X < b)", color=COLOR_2, font_size=28)
        # Fix Issue 34: Use area placement for label
        self.place_in_area(prob_label, "B3", "B5", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(shade_area), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(Flash(shade_area, color=COLOR_2, flash_radius=1.2))
        self.play(Write(prob_label))
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(COLOR_3))
        
        # Show full area shaded
        full_shade = axes.get_area(bell_plot, x_range=[0, 4], color=COLOR_3, opacity=0.3)
        total_area_label = MathTex(r"\text{Total Area} = 1", color=COLOR_3, font_size=32)
        # Fix Issue 35: Use area placement for label
        self.place_in_area(total_area_label, "A2", "A5", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(shade_area),
            FadeOut(prob_label),
            FadeIn(full_shade),
            Write(total_area_label)
        )
        # Highlight the final bell shape
        self.play(bell_svg_final.animate.set_color(COLOR_3))
        self.wait(3)
